shots.purpose: Cold-open reveal: the three eyes of Adya Kali open in the void before creation, setting the goddess as the source of the whole story.

beats.action: Syllable sparks drift inward; in the dark, Kali's right eye opens, calm and deep
beats.audio_cue: a low bell blooms as the first eye opens

beats.action: Her left eye opens; the brows soften, the gaze is steady and kind
The forehead eye opens with a small Rani Pink glint; the crescent above catches cool light
beats.audio_cue: a soft breath-like rush of fire

beats.action: All three eyes stay open and calm; strands of open hair lift like smoke behind her head
A faint smile reaches the eyes; the bone-white skulls of her garland glint as they sway
Her gaze lowers toward the viewer with compassion
beats.audio_cue: the hum thins to a single tone

sfx.description: a low bell blooms out of silence as the first eye opens
a soft rush of fire as the forehead eye opens

en.speaker: NARRATOR
en.text: Before the world began, she was already there.

hi.speaker: NARRATOR
hi.text: दुनिया बनने से पहले भी, वो वहाँ थीं।

mr.speaker: NARRATOR
mr.text: जग बनण्याच्या आधीसुद्धा, ती तिथे होती.

continuity.incoming: Opening shot: the indigo void is already in slow motion, with syllable sparks drifting inward toward the centre.
continuity.outgoing: All three eyes are open and the gaze lowers toward the viewer, ready to carry down to the boon hand.

shots.purpose: Short iconography voice-over: her sword cuts bondage and her open hand gives freedom, then the void dims into the story.

beats.action: Kali's boon palm lowers toward the viewer; her eyes follow it, gentle
Her other hand raises the khadga upright; the brows firm with resolve
The khadga holds still; its edge catches the cool rim from the crescent
The crimson lower garment lifts in a slow wind and settles one beat late on the lotus seat
Her whole figure stills, eyes calm; the glow core behind her dims

sfx.description: a clean ring of steel as the sword comes upright
a slow wind moving through the void

en.speaker: NARRATOR
en.text: Her sword cuts our chains. Her open hand sets us free.

hi.speaker: NARRATOR
hi.text: उनकी तलवार बंधन काटती है। खुला हाथ आज़ाद करता है।

mr.speaker: NARRATOR
mr.text: तिची तलवार आपल्या बेड्या तोडते. तिचा उघडा हात आपल्याला मोकळं करतो.

continuity.incoming: Match on gaze: Kali's lowered eyes from SHOT-001 lead the camera down to her boon hand.
continuity.outgoing: The full seated figure stills and the glow core dims, handing a dimming void to the dawn hermitage.

shots.purpose: Frame story: the Himalayan munis ask how Sati was born and how Shiva married, and Markandeya begins the telling that came from Brahma.
shots.flip_marker: HARD CUT — new place: indigo void with centre glow to dawn hermitage, sun from screen left

beats.action: The munis on the left lean in, eyes lifting toward the sage
beats.audio_cue: dawn birdsong and the sound of the stream

beats.action: The lead muni's brows rise in a question; his hands join at the chest
beats.audio_cue: kusha mats creak as they shift

beats.action: The munis nod together, eyes fixed on Markandeya, waiting
beats.audio_cue: a soft rustle of bark garments

beats.action: Markandeya turns one mala bead; his eyes close to recall
He raises his teaching palm; the shawl edge lifts in the dawn breeze and settles late
beats.audio_cue: a soft wind through the deodar

beats.action: His eyes open, calm and bright; the beard sways a beat after his head

en.speaker: CHAR-HIMALAYAN-MUNIS
en.text: How was Sati born and wed?

hi.speaker: CHAR-MARKANDEYA
hi.text: सुनो। ब्रह्मा ने पहले ये सुनाई।

continuity.incoming: Hard cut from the dimmed void: the munis are already leaning in toward the sage in the first frame.
continuity.outgoing: A curl of fire-stone smoke rises past Markandeya into the sky, carrying the eye up toward the clouds.

shots.purpose: Brahma creates the gods, sages and Daksha; from his meditation Sandhya is born, shown with dignity and a lowered gaze.
shots.flip_marker: HARD CUT — new place: dawn sun left to cloud-court light upper right

beats.action: Brahma on the lotus throne turns his creating palm upward; the eyes of his front face open
The mind-born sages appear in a row on the right, eyes widening in wonder
beats.audio_cue: a soft chime as each figure forms

beats.action: Brahma's front eyes close in meditation; his palm stays raised
A soft golden light gathers above the petal step on the left
The light becomes Sandhya: four arms, a fully draped twilight-violet sari, the veil over both shoulders
beats.audio_cue: a single clear bell as she forms

beats.action: Sandhya's eyes open, startled like a doe's; she lowers her gaze at once
beats.audio_cue: a soft breath of air through cloth

beats.action: She draws the veil across with one hand and stands still with dignity, two hands folded
The sages exchange puzzled looks; Brahma's eyes open again and his gaze turns inward

sfx.description: soft chimes as each mind-born sage forms
one clear bell as Sandhya takes form

en.speaker: NARRATOR
en.text: Brahma made the gods, the sages and Daksha. Then, from his deep thought, a daughter was born.

hi.speaker: NARRATOR
hi.text: ब्रह्मा जी ने देवता, ऋषि और दक्ष बनाए। फिर उनके ध्यान से एक बेटी जन्मी।

mr.speaker: NARRATOR
mr.text: ब्रह्मदेवांनी देव, ऋषी आणि दक्ष घडवले. मग त्यांच्या ध्यानातून एक मुलगी जन्मली.

continuity.incoming: Smoke rising from SHOT-003 dissolves into cloud; the camera arrives already craning down onto the lotus court.
continuity.outgoing: Brahma's eyes reopen and turn inward as a golden light begins to gather at his chest.

shots.purpose: Re-hook reveal: Kamadeva is born golden from Brahma's mind with the flower bow, kneels, and asks for his work, a place and a wife.

beats.action: A golden light swells at Brahma's chest; the brows of his front face lift in surprise
The light pours down onto the petal step in front of a dark pillar
The light becomes a youth with golden skin and red-tinged hands, face and feet
Kamadeva's eyes open; a playful half smile appears
beats.audio_cue: a light bowstring twang with a soft tick

beats.action: He finds the flower bow in his left hand and looks at it, curious
beats.audio_cue: bees hum faintly on the bowstring

beats.action: He kneels on one knee before Brahma and bows his head low
beats.audio_cue: knee touches the petal step softly

beats.action: His garland swings forward and settles a beat late; his eyes lift to Brahma, eager
The sages far behind lean in, astonished; Kamadeva waits with bright eyes
beats.audio_cue: a soft rustle of cloth as the sages shift

sfx.description: a rushing breath as the light pours onto the step
a light twang as Kamadeva's eyes open

en.speaker: NARRATOR
en.text: Then another was born of his mind, golden.

en.speaker: CHAR-KAMADEVA
en.text: Lord, what's my work? Give me a home and wife.

hi.speaker: NARRATOR
hi.text: फिर उनके मन से एक और जन्मा, सोने-सा पीला।

hi.speaker: CHAR-KAMADEVA
hi.text: प्रभु, मेरा काम क्या? घर और पत्नी दीजिए।

mr.speaker: NARRATOR
mr.text: मग त्यांच्या मनातून आणखी एक आला, सोनेरी.

mr.speaker: CHAR-KAMADEVA
mr.text: प्रभू, माझं काम काय? मला घर द्या, आणि बायकोही.

continuity.incoming: Golden light stirring at Brahma's chest at the end of SHOT-004 swells in the first frame.
continuity.outgoing: Kamadeva kneels with eager eyes on Brahma; Brahma's palm is about to rise over him.

shots.purpose: Brahma gives Kamadeva his task over every heart, even Vishnu's and Shiva's; the sages name him, and he notches an arrow with a bold thought.

beats.action: Brahma raises his creating palm over Kamadeva; his eyes are steady and commanding
Kamadeva's eyes widen at the words, then sparkle with delight
He rises from his knee, chest lifting with pride; the dhoti pleats swing and settle late
Far behind, the sages raise folded hands toward him one after another, naming him
beats.audio_cue: soft palms meeting with a light tap in a ripple

beats.action: Kamadeva lifts the flower bow; the fine bee string glints
He draws one flower arrow from his sash and notches it; the tip glints
beats.audio_cue: a light click of the arrow on the string

beats.action: His eyes slide toward Brahma; a sly half smile forms
beats.audio_cue: the hum cuts to near silence

sfx.description: a ripple of joined palms as the sages name him
a light click as the flower arrow meets the string

en.speaker: CHAR-BRAHMA
en.text: Your flower arrows win every heart, even Shiva's.

hi.speaker: CHAR-BRAHMA
hi.text: तुम्हारे बाण शिव को भी जीतेंगे।

mr.speaker: CHAR-BRAHMA
mr.text: तुझे बाण सर्वांचं मन जिंकतील, शिवांचंही.

continuity.incoming: Kamadeva is still kneeling at center-right from SHOT-005 as Brahma's palm rises over him.
continuity.outgoing: Kamadeva stands with an arrow notched and a sly glance toward Brahma; his bow arm is about to draw.

shots.purpose: Reversal: Kamadeva tests Brahma's words on Brahma's own court; the sweet wind sweeps through, Sandhya turns away and Brahma struggles, shown with restraint.

beats.action: Kamadeva draws the bow back; his eyes narrow on his aim
beats.audio_cue: the bowstring creaks as it stretches

beats.action: Full draw, held tight; the dhoti flares and his curls lift
beats.audio_cue: bees on the string hum louder

beats.action: Release: the flower arrow leaps across the court with a bright trail
beats.audio_cue: a sharp twang and a whoosh

beats.action: A wave of petals and warm wind sweeps across the petal steps
On the left, Sandhya draws her veil close and turns her face away, gaze lowered
beats.audio_cue: a veil snaps softly in the wind

beats.action: Far at center, Brahma grips the arms of his throne; a bead of sweat forms on his brow
Brahma's four heads lower and his eyes shut tight, struggling to hold himself
Petals drift down; Kamadeva lowers the bow, pleased, with a small smile
beats.audio_cue: the wind dies to a whisper

sfx.description: a sharp twang and whoosh as the arrow flies

en.speaker: NARRATOR
en.text: He aimed at Brahma's own court. Every mind wavered.

hi.speaker: NARRATOR
hi.text: उसने ब्रह्मा जी की सभा पर बाण चलाया। सबका मन डोला।

mr.speaker: NARRATOR
mr.text: त्याने सभेवर बाण सोडला. सगळ्यांचं मन डळमळलं.

continuity.incoming: Kamadeva's bow arm begins its draw from the notched pose of SHOT-006.
continuity.outgoing: Petals settle; Kamadeva lowers the bow, pleased, as a cold cloud shadow starts to slide across the gold steps.

shots.purpose: Shiva appears out of the cloud shadow and rebukes Brahma; Brahma and the sages bow their heads in shame, and Brahma's anger turns toward Kamadeva.

beats.action: A cloud shadow slides over the court; Shiva steps out of it on the left, eyes open and stern
beats.audio_cue: a soft dry rustle as the wind dies down

beats.action: Shiva lifts two fingers and points at Brahma; his brows knit
beats.audio_cue: a heavy rustle of tiger skin

beats.audio_cue: a long soft breath of cloth

beats.action: The sages on the right lower their heads in shame, hands at their chests
beats.audio_cue: a soft knock of kamandalus as the hands drop

beats.action: Shiva's pointing hand lowers slowly; his gaze stays fixed on Brahma
beats.audio_cue: a faint dry rustle of cloth

beats.action: Brahma's palms close over his knees; a drop of sweat falls from his brow
beats.audio_cue: a single tap of a drop on the petal step

beats.action: Brahma's eyes open and flash toward screen right, shame turning to anger

sfx.description: the warm wind dies away as the cloud shadow passes

en.speaker: CHAR-SHIVA
en.text: Brahma, she's your own daughter. How could you?

en.speaker: NARRATOR
en.text: Brahma and the sages hung their heads in shame.

hi.speaker: CHAR-SHIVA
hi.text: ब्रह्मा जी, वो आपकी बेटी है। मन कैसे डोला?

hi.speaker: NARRATOR
hi.text: ब्रह्मा जी और मुनि शर्म से झुक गए।

mr.speaker: CHAR-SHIVA
mr.text: ब्रह्मदेव, ती तुमचीच मुलगी आहे. मन कसं डळमळलं?

mr.speaker: NARRATOR
mr.text: ब्रह्मदेव आणि ऋषींनी लाजेने मान खाली घातली.

continuity.incoming: The cold cloud shadow from the end of SHOT-007 slides over the court in the first frame, and Shiva steps out of it.
continuity.outgoing: Brahma's eyes flash toward screen right, where Kamadeva stands off frame.

shots.purpose: Reversal: Brahma, shamed, curses Kamadeva that Mahadeva's eye fire will burn him; Kamadeva's pride turns to fear.

beats.action: Brahma's eyes snap onto Kamadeva; his brows draw down in anger
beats.audio_cue: a sharp rustle of the uttariya

Brahma rises from the throne; the uttariya swings out and lags

The curse lands in a white flash; Kamadeva flinches back a step
Kamadeva's bow slips under his arm; his hands tremble, eyes fixed on Brahma
Brahma's pointing arm stays raised; his eyes are hard and unmoving
Brahma's arm drops slowly and his breath goes out; anger begins to cool in his eyes

en.speaker: CHAR-BRAHMA
en.text: You shot at me? Fire from Mahadeva's eye will burn you.

hi.speaker: CHAR-BRAHMA
hi.text: बाण? महादेव की आँख तुम्हें जलाएगी।

mr.speaker: CHAR-BRAHMA
mr.text: माझ्यावर बाण? महादेवांच्या डोळ्यांची आग जाळेल.

continuity.incoming: Brahma's eyes, already flashing to screen right at the end of SHOT-008, snap onto Kamadeva.
continuity.outgoing: Brahma's arm drops and his breath goes out; Kamadeva trembles, bow slipping under his arm.

shots.purpose: Cliffhanger: Kamadeva kneels and pleads that he only obeyed; Brahma draws breath to answer, and the last two seconds hold on the open question of whether the curse can be undone.

en.speaker: CHAR-KAMADEVA
en.text: You said aim at everyone. Why blame me?

en.speaker: NARRATOR
en.text: Would Brahma ever take it back?

hi.speaker: CHAR-KAMADEVA
hi.text: आपने कहा, सब पर चलाओ। मेरी गलती क्या?

mr.speaker: CHAR-KAMADEVA
mr.text: सर्वांवर सोडा म्हणालात! माझी चूक काय?

continuity.incoming: Kamadeva sinks to his knees from the trembling pose of SHOT-009, with Brahma still at center behind him.
continuity.outgoing: Episode end: Kamadeva frozen in plea, a last petal resting on his bow, Brahma's silhouette turning toward him.
